# Veritas HomeServices LLC

> Licensed, insured, owner-operated residential pest control serving Fort Myers,
> San Carlos Park, Estero, Bonita Springs and nearby Southwest Florida communities.
> Services include general pest control, monthly spider control, German roach
> clean-up, rodent control, bed bug treatment, flea & tick treatment, mosquito
> control, and HOA/property management pest programs.

## Services

- [General Pest Control](https://veritashomeservices.com/pest-control-fort-myers): Routine residential protection with interior/exterior options, recurring service available.
- [Monthly Spider Control](https://veritashomeservices.com/spider-control-fort-myers): Exterior treatment plus accessible web removal, starting at $35/month.
- [German Roach Clean-Up](https://veritashomeservices.com/german-roach-cleanup-fort-myers): Structured 4-visit program for qualifying residential properties, starting at $225.
- [Rodent Control](https://veritashomeservices.com/rodent-control-fort-myers): Inspection, monitoring, and targeted control recommendations.
- [Bed Bug Treatment](https://veritashomeservices.com/bed-bug-treatment-fort-myers): Property-specific inspection and treatment recommendations.
- [Flea & Tick Treatment](https://veritashomeservices.com/flea-tick-treatment-fort-myers): Targeted treatment with preparation guidance when applicable.
- [Mosquito Control](https://veritashomeservices.com/mosquito-control-fort-myers): Outdoor service targeting resting and breeding areas.
- [HOA & Property Management](https://veritashomeservices.com/hoa-property-management-pest-control): Custom service plans for residential communities.
